The 23 NV0000_CTRL_GPU_ID_INFO_* defines at src/common/sdk/nvidia/inc/ctrl/ctrl0000/ctrl0000gpu.h:189-211 belong to the gpuId bitfield of NV0000_CTRL_GPU_ID_INFO_PARAMS, a different field in a different struct. They are also not values: NV0000_CTRL_GPU_ID_INFO_IN_USE is the bit range 0:0 and the _FALSE and _TRUE members are that one bit's two states. The gpuId of NV0000_CTRL_GPU_ACTIVE_DEVICE, declared at ctrl0000gpu.h:995, is an opaque identifier the driver returns and carries no enumeration. A class-prefix rule bound the two together; the struct-or-stem anchor does not derive the family at all, and this record states the decision so the defect stays visible.
